label: Twilio
description: Twilio account SIDs, auth tokens, and API keys.

signals.reason: An account SID (AC) names a Twilio account.
A standard API key (SK) sends messages and calls. It cannot change the account or its keys.
The auth token acts for the whole account, with its settings and keys.
Twilio sends real text messages and calls. A sent message cannot be undone.
The item name or a label names Twilio.
A host of the item is a Twilio host.
